title: R&SVP – Hio Ridge | Barn wedding venue, Bridgton, Maine
description: A barn raised in 1820 on a family farm in Bridgton, Maine. Sunday weddings for up to 135, the ceremony facing Pleasant Mountain. Alcohol-free. Now booking 2027.

hero.alt: Inside the barn at Hio Ridge in the evening: the timber frame, chandeliers, and the loft rail
hero.headline: Your wedding in a barn raised in 1820
hero.line: Bridgton, Maine. Sundays, May through October.

statement.quote: If these walls could talk, they would have stories to tell. We are ready for the first new ones.

intro.heading: The farm has been ours since 1941. The barn is yours for the day.
body: Susan's great-grandparents bought this farm on Hio Ridge Road in 1941. Her grandmother retired here, then her father, and now Susan and Richard. In 2020 they took the barn down to its frame and put it back together with its own boards and the windows from the house.
It holds 135 guests. The ell beside it has a room for the bride and a room for the groom. The field in front looks at Pleasant Mountain.
intro.alt: Looking down the barn toward the French doors, a chandelier overhead

paths.title: Weddings
paths.body: The ceremony in the field, the reception under the beams, and the two of you getting ready in the ell.
paths.alt: Benches made from the barn's old floorboards, set in the field among birches

paths.title: The Barn
paths.body: The main floor and the loft, the bridal and groom rooms, a kitchen for your caterer, the patio and the grounds.
paths.alt: The bridal room: sheer curtains, a vanity, an arched mirror and a round rug

paths.title: Events
paths.body: Showers, reunions, retreats, teas and small concerts. Any day but Saturday.
paths.alt: The barn across the lawn with round tables set on the patio

setting.heading: October is the month to see it
setting.body: The field looks straight at Pleasant Mountain, and in October the color comes right down to the barn. We give tours by appointment all month.
setting.alt: The barn across the lawn in early October, trees turning along the tree line

evening.heading: Evenings on the ridge
evening.body: String lights on the patio, the stone circle in the field, and the sun going down behind the barn.
evening.alt: The barn at night, windows lit, French doors open onto the patio

proof.title: Open house
proof.body: Tours of the barn and the ell, with the High Street Jazz Band playing inside.

proof.title: Ribbon cutting
proof.body: The Maine Lakes Chamber of Commerce, filmed by Lakes Region TV.

proof.title: Occupancy approved
proof.body: Town of Bridgton. 135 guests, May through October.

story_teaser.heading: Susan and Richard
story_teaser.body: They spend the season here and the winter in California. They give every tour themselves, and they are at every event.
story_teaser.alt: Susan and Richard Voth at the barn door

closing.heading: Come stand in it
closing.body: Photos only go so far. We will walk you through the barn, the ell and the field, and answer everything.
